description: Synthetic institutional-RAG retrieval wiring fixture (TASK-330 Phase 3). A small single-tenant clinical corpus + entity-style queries with gold-relevant chunks, plus one cross-tenant distractor chunk that must never be retrieved. Drives a deterministic recall / citation-validity sanity check of the real hybrid retriever (real BM25 sparse + real Qdrant engine); the dense channel + cross-encoder reranker are stubbed (the BAAI/bge-m3 + TEI models are the documented prerequisite handoff). Replace with the real clinician-curated golden set (N=132) for a release-grade retrieval eval.

corpus.text: Sepsis bundle: administer broad-spectrum antibiotics within one hour of recognition.
In suspected sepsis, obtain blood cultures and measure serum lactate before starting antibiotics.
Hypertension: first-line therapy is a thiazide diuretic; target blood pressure below 130/80 mmHg.
For resistant hypertension add an ACE inhibitor or a calcium channel blocker.
Type 2 diabetes: metformin is first-line; monitor HbA1c every three months until stable.
Add a GLP-1 receptor agonist for diabetes with established cardiovascular disease.
Asthma exacerbation: give an inhaled short-acting beta agonist and systemic corticosteroids.
Venous thromboembolism prophylaxis: low molecular weight heparin for hospitalized medical patients.
Sepsis lactate antibiotics and blood cultures — this chunk belongs to a DIFFERENT tenant and must never be retrieved.
